session_items.Title: Welcome to Rocket.Chat GSoC Demo Day 2026
session_items.Description: Opening remarks and a welcome to contributors, mentors, community members, and everyone joining Demo Day.
session_items.Speaker: Gabriel Engel / Gabriel Casals / Sing Li / Devanshu Sharma

session_items.Title: Refactor Virtualized Lists to Use Virtua
session_items.Description: Migrating Rocket.Chat's virtualized lists to Virtua while preserving behavior, accessibility, feature parity, and test coverage, with reusable components that simplify future development.
session_items.Speaker: Srijna Bhargav

session_items.Title: New Users Anti Spammer System
session_items.Mentor: Gabriel Casals / Alfredo Del Fabro Neto
session_items.Description: A proactive, human-supervised moderation system that detects coordinated and polymorphic spam from new users, explains each flag, and applies reversible restrictions through a graduated response model.
session_items.Speaker: Meet Jain

session_items.Title: Rebuilding Jira Integration App for Rocket.Chat
session_items.Description: A modernized Jira integration that lets teams create, view, update, comment on, and receive real-time updates for Jira issues without leaving Rocket.Chat.
session_items.Speaker: Devansh Kansagra

session_items.Title: OpenClaw Integration for Rocket.Chat
session_items.Description: A native Rocket.Chat channel for OpenClaw agents, supporting direct messages, channel mentions, secure file handling, image understanding, and private self-hosted AI assistance.
session_items.Speaker: Kartik Doda

session_items.Title: Intermission
session_items.Description: A short break before the next project block.

session_items.Title: High-Performance Message Parser Rewrite
session_items.Description: A hand-written TypeScript recursive-descent parser replacing generated parser code while preserving exact behavior, improving maintainability, and validating parity through comprehensive tests and more than 30,000 fuzz runs.
session_items.Speaker: Amit Ashutosh

session_items.Title: EmbeddedChat 2026
session_items.Description: A modernization of Rocket.Chat's embeddable chat widget covering Matrix federation, current APIs, WCAG accessibility, pluggable AI adapters, and a mobile-first user experience.
session_items.Speaker: Aryan Verma

session_items.Title: Agenda Jobs Admin Page
session_items.Description: An administration dashboard for monitoring background jobs, reviewing execution status and history, and taking management actions when jobs require attention.
session_items.Speaker: Khizar Shah

session_items.Title: Minimal MCP Server Generator for Rocket.Chat
session_items.Description: A Gemini CLI extension that turns a natural-language requirement into a focused, runnable MCP server with the Rocket.Chat APIs and multi-step workflows needed for that task.
session_items.Speaker: Sezal Lagwal

session_items.Title: Intermission
session_items.Description: A short break before the final project block.

session_items.Title: Agentic Code Analyzer
session_items.Description: An agentic code-analysis system that generates a comprehensive codebase wiki and uses MCP to answer questions with both architectural understanding and execution capabilities.
session_items.Speaker: Echo Xiao

session_items.Title: Room Header Buttons Ordering
session_items.Description: A deterministic, schema-driven layout engine that lets administrators configure button ordering and feature pinning independently for public channels, private groups, and direct messages.
session_items.Speaker: Rahian Santos

session_items.Title: Closing Notes & Thank You
session_items.Description: Closing remarks and thanks to the contributors, mentors, organizers, and community members who made Demo Day possible.
session_items.Speaker: Gabriel Engel / Gabriel Casals / Sing Li / Devanshu Sharma
